what: The DECLARED top-level fields of OpenClaw's `sessions_spawn` tool schema, per host version, as measured — never as guessed. `src/defence/iron-dome/tool-input-schema.ts` carries the same revisions and a test pins the two together, so the reviewed contract cannot be widened by hand without a measurement landing here first (ADR-002 §5C, #594).
how: node scripts/measure-native-contract.mjs --root <openclaw install root>  (append the printed revision; keep ascending by hostVersion). `--check` verifies an install against this record.

evidence.note: The 28-field bag measured from `createSessionsSpawnToolSchema` / `VISIBLE_SESSIONS_SPAWN_SCHEMA` in the host source at the 30 Aug 2026 widening, plus `timeoutSeconds`, which the pre-visible shipped schema still accepted. The version string is the one the sibling `openclaw.exec` bag in the same module records for the same measurement era; it was not re-measured from a shipped dist. Kept as the floor revision for hosts older than the first dist-measured one.
